Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Do not purchase wallpaper from Lulu and…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a3b23d6cfb5c6821ac0e825)
Do not purchase wallpaper from Lulu and Georgia. They had two separate instructions, one online and one with the paper. Our experienced installer who successfully wallpapered two other rooms prior, ended up with mottled results. Watermarks that remained on the paper. We had to pay to take it down and then pay again to put new paper up, doubling my installation costs. We consulted two other installers who refused to work with the LuLu and Georgia paper. L&G refunded the cost of the paper but not the redo on the installation.

May 14, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 25, 2026

Hi Gail,

Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate your understanding as we worked to resolve the issue by refunding the cost of the wallpaper. I can see how frustrating it must be to deal with installation challenges, and we recommend sourcing experienced installers familiar with specific wallpaper styles to ensure optimal results. If you have any further questions, please let us know, as we are happy to help.

Lulu and Georgia
